name: European gas (TTF)
summary: European gas near €88/MWh on 20 Nov, above the €70 Alert line, with EU storage near 70% against a 89% norm
state: Dutch TTF gas was near €88.45/MWh on 20 Nov, 4.4% higher on the week and 33% higher over three months, above the €70 Alert line (Yahoo Finance). EU storage was below 71% in mid-November against a five-year seasonal average of 89%, with Middle East hostilities, Hormuz attacks and Norwegian outages cited as drivers (Trading Economics, 16 Nov).
for_you: High wholesale gas prices feed into household and business energy bills over months; Ofgem sets the GB price cap each quarter.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — Dutch TTF gas futures
Trading Economics — European Natural Gas Prices Drop Further

why: European gas sets UK and EU power prices and heating bills; Europe has had no cushion since losing Russian pipeline gas.
drivers: LNG supply, storage levels, weather, Norwegian outages, Middle East LNG routes.

rubric.alert: TTF > €70/MWh, or a major supply cut-off (e.g. Qatar LNG or Norway outage > 1 week).
rubric.watch: TTF €40–70/MWh, or storage > 10 points below seasonal norm.
rubric.normal: TTF < €40/MWh and EU storage at or above seasonal norm.
